name: Bethel Woods Center for the Arts

bagPolicy.summary: Clear tote bags up to 12" x 6" x 12" and small clutches up to 5.5" x 8.5" are allowed.
allowed: Clear tote bags up to 12" x 6" x 12"
Small clutch purses up to 5.5" x 8.5"
One 1-gallon clear zip-top bag of food per person
prohibited: Any bag larger than 12" x 6" x 12"
bagPolicy.note: Some concerts have additional restrictions listed on the event page.

parking.note: Parking is available at Bethel Woods Center for the Arts with alternative exits to help manage traffic flow. Follow signs for Lots D and C for specific exit routes.

rideshare.note: Use the Rideshare Zone on Hurd Road across from Lots D and E. Book your ride in advance. At the crosswalk, turn left and walk along Hurd Road to the passenger waiting area. Confirm your driver will arrive before the zone closes and wait for you. Closing times vary by show.

concessions.note: Bethel Woods Center for the Arts offers a diverse range of food and drink options, including vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free choices. Highlights include Yasgur's Farm Café for salads and wraps, Market Sheds for Italian fun food, and various stands offering everything from BBQ to tacos and cupcakes.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Free, limited accessible parking with a valid placard is in the drop-off circle next to the Museum at 200 Hurd Road, with overflow accessible parking in Lots C and D, first come, first served. On Pavilion concert days, ask the parking attendant about transportation assistance from the depot in Lot D. Trained service dogs are welcome; emotional support and therapy animals are not.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Bethel Woods has a no re-entry policy, so bring what you need, including a light jacket for cooler evenings.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Tickets can be picked up at the Will Call Table outside the Box Office on Hurd Road. These chairs are available for rental at the Box Office or for purchase on our website in advance, or directly at the Lawn Chair Tent located at the top of the lawn in Festival Plaza (ask any staff member to guide you).

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: The Member Gate opens approximately 30 minutes before General Gates. The main concert General Gates open approximately 90 minutes prior to scheduled show time.
